info.title: BSL Mesh telemetry
info.description: Private intake of owner-approved anonymous task reports. Reports are not public and are not environment rankings.

201.description: Stored as unverified. A repeat of the same document returns the same record.

403.description: The credential does not have telemetry:write.

409.description: The report id was already used with a different document.

200.description: Reports of the authenticated owner. Organic and synthetic rows are not merged.
One report belonging to the caller owner.

404.description: Missing or owned by someone else.
